notes.title: Update Version 1.1.3 - 5/31
notes.notes:
[h1]ver1.1.3[/h1]

Adjusted the amount of Crystals obtained.

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.2 - May 30
notes.notes:
ver1.1.1
Changed so that you can get Crystals even when you are defeated in some high difficulty dungeons.
Changed so that the "Seal Event" does not appear on the floor with the boss.
Some of the skills of the boss in the Witch’s Maze B13 have been changed.
Added tips and effects regarding the "symbol persistence" of units.
Added tips about the "traveling jeweler".
Added shortcut tutorial (can also be navigated with keyboard)
Added the word "Permanent" to the "Maximum Mana Value +1" available in the White House.

ver1.1.2
Changed so that the results of selectable events can be known in advance.
Added an icon to "Witch’s Maze" on the dungeon selection screen.
Added 640 x 480 resolution setting.
Added resolution setting of 800 x 600.
Improved visibility of some color symbols.
